test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

A wide-ranging effort is being made to safeguard lives and livelihoods by addressing the **__devastating__** near-term socio-economic, humanitarian, and human rights aspects of the crisis with attention to those hit the hardest.
solution:
The correct answer is "**destructive**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word "devastating" means that destroys something completely. (पूर्णतया विनाशकारी)

 
 
• Example:* If the bomb had exploded in the main shopping area, it would have been **devastating**__.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of "devastating" is "destructive."
 
• The word "destructive" means causing a lot of harm or damage. (विनाशकारी, विध्वंसक)
 __
 
• Example:* Lack of trust is very **destructive**__ in a relationship.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• **Flourishing: **to be strong and healthy; to develop in a successful way. (सशक्त होते जाना; फलना-फूलना; सफलता की ओर अग्रसर होना; उन्‍नति करना)
 
• **Emerging: **to appear or come out from somewhere. (कहीं से प्रकट होना या निकलना)
 
• **Fortunate: **lucky. (भाग्‍यशाली)
